assembly_purchase_policy: Buy factory-soldered headers/connectors wherever the exact selected module offers them. Prefer precrimped mating cables. This does not make a bare carrier plug-and-play: carrier joints, passive parts, power perfboard and two XIAO recovery pads still require soldering.
